items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: did, uh, Jimmy Hoskins stay on playing drums?

ctx.x: And then he was, it wasn't long before, um... Saunders. Red, Red Saunders came in. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.

Uh, let's see, uh, Delbert Bright might have had that, uh, uh, did, uh, did, uh, Jimmy Hoskins stay on playing drums? If you haven't remembered him, Little Pella. Uh, and, uh, Ike Perkins guitar? Ike was there.
